input.content: Pattern: flipping a default flag sends the default path into a previously opt-in code path that has untested boundary bugs. Example: setting DETAILED_REPORT=True made report([]) call summarize(..., detailed=True), which runs sum/len on an empty list and raises ZeroDivisionError. The explicit detailed=True path already had this bug, but empty input was never tested on it. Review check: when a default changes, trace the newly defaulted branch against every documented boundary case (empty, zero, None) and confirm tests cover each one in the new default mode, not only populated inputs.
